title: Breaking: Canada hedline CPI rose 3.0% YoY in August
summary: Canada’s inflation held its pace in August, with the headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) rising 3.0% from a year earlier, matching market expectations and unchanged from the 3.0% increase recorded in July. On a monthly basis, prices declined by 0.1%.

title: Federal Reserve: Inflation keeps pressure on – Commerzbank
summary: Commerzbank economists note that August US CPI data were broadly in line with expectations but still too high for the Federal Reserve. They stress excessive underlying price pressure and say the Fed has already signaled readiness to hike.

title: Oil: Geopolitical supply risks tilt bias higher – OCBC
summary: OCBC strategist Christopher Wong says oil risks have risen again as disruptions to Saudi export infrastructure and renewed concerns around the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb keep supply risks elevated.
